summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the ELZONRIS (tagraxofusp) BLA761116 application. The Summary Review (Section 9) states the application was not discussed by an Advisory Committee, and the Medical Review (Section 9) independently confirms there was no advisory committee meeting for this application. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
